key: AME: Please, continue.
en: AME: Please, continue.
ja: アメ: どうぞ、続けて。

key: INSPECTOR: Right.
en: INSPECTOR: Right.
ja: 捜査官: よし。

key: INSPECTOR: So, where were we...
en: INSPECTOR: So, where were we...
ja: 捜査官: それで、どこまで話したっけな……

key: Ah, right.
en: Ah, right.
ja: ああ、そうだ。

key: You were just about to tell me about your little friends?
en: You were just about to tell me about your little friends?
ja: お仲間について、話してくれるところだったよな?

key: CULPRIT: I'm not gonna talk.
en: CULPRIT: I'm not gonna talk.
ja: 犯人: 何もしゃべらねえよ。

key: I ain't gonna say a word.
en: I ain't gonna say a word.
ja: 一言も、口を割らねえ。

key: INSPECTOR: Mm... About that.
en: INSPECTOR: Mm... About that.
ja: 捜査官: ふむ……その件だが。

key: Let me introduce you to my friend, Torkoal.
en: Let me introduce you to my friend, Torkoal.
ja: オレの相棒、コータスを紹介させてくれ。

key: INSPECTOR: Now, my buddy Torkoal here...
en: INSPECTOR: Now, my buddy Torkoal here...
ja: 捜査官: このコータスなんだが……

key: He isn't the most patient fella.
en: He isn't the most patient fella.
ja: 我慢強い奴じゃなくてな。

key: And when people keep him waiting, he tends to blow a bit of hot air, so to speak.
en: And when people keep him waiting, he tends to blow a bit of hot air, so to speak.
ja: 待たされると、まあ、熱い空気を吹き出す癖があるんだ。

key: Which brings me to my second point.
en: Which brings me to my second point.
ja: それで、二つ目の話になるんだが。

key: You know what kind of chair you're strapped in, right?
en: You know what kind of chair you're strapped in, right?
ja: お前が縛りつけられてる椅子、何でできてるかわかるよな?

key: CULPRIT: Uh, metal?
en: CULPRIT: Uh, metal?
ja: 犯人: あー、金属?

key: INSPECTOR: You're not completely dumb. Good.
en: INSPECTOR: You're not completely dumb. Good.
ja: 捜査官: 完全にバカってわけじゃないんだな。よし。

key: So, Torkoal here gets a little fired up, right? When people don't answer.
en: So, Torkoal here gets a little fired up, right? When people don't answer.
ja: それで、コータスはちょっと熱くなるんだよ、な? 答えない奴がいるとな。

key: And I think even you can figure out what happens to metal when it gets heated up.
en: And I think even you can figure out what happens to metal when it gets heated up.
ja: 金属が熱くなったらどうなるか、お前でもわかるだろ。

key: So really the choice is yours, friend.
en: So really the choice is yours, friend.
ja: だから、選ぶのはお前次第だぜ、相棒。

key: Tell us about your teammates, or you'll be in the hot seat, literally.
en: Tell us about your teammates, or you'll be in the hot seat, literally.
ja: 仲間について話すか、それとも文字通り「熱い椅子」に座り続けるか。

key: I'll ask again: Who are you working with?
en: I'll ask again: Who are you working with?
ja: もう一度聞くぞ:誰と組んでる?

key: CULPRIT: I'm not gonna talk... I swore!
en: CULPRIT: I'm not gonna talk... I swore!
ja: 犯人: しゃべらねえよ……誓ったんだ!

key: INSPECTOR: Mm... Torkoal?
en: INSPECTOR: Mm... Torkoal?
ja: 捜査官: ふむ……コータス?

key: How do you feel about that, buddy?
en: How do you feel about that, buddy?
ja: それについて、どう思う、相棒?

key: CULPRIT: ...Aaaaghh!!
en: CULPRIT: ...Aaaaghh!!
ja: 犯人: ……ぎゃああっ!!

key: Who goes there?!
en: Who goes there?!
ja: 誰だ、そこにいるのは?!

key: Oh, it's just you, \PN.
en: Oh, it's just you, \PN.
ja: ああ、お前か、\PN。

key: Gee, I heard you paid for all of the restoration projects out of your own pocket!
en: Gee, I heard you paid for all of the restoration projects out of your own pocket!
ja: なあ、修復プロジェクトの費用、全部自腹で払ったって聞いたぞ!

key: That's really something, you know?
en: That's really something, you know?
ja: それって、すごいことだよな?

key: Where do you even get all the money?
en: Where do you even get all the money?
ja: そのお金、一体どこから手に入れてるんだ?

key: It kinda reminds me of a trick my cousin told me one time--
en: It kinda reminds me of a trick my cousin told me one time--
ja: いとこが昔教えてくれたコツを、なんか思い出すな――

key: He said, if anyone ever asks you for a password, you can tell them "moneybags".
en: He said, if anyone ever asks you for a password, you can tell them "moneybags".
ja: 誰かにパスワードを聞かれたら、「moneybags」って答えろってさ。

key: If you do that, good wealth and fortune is sure to come your way.
en: If you do that, good wealth and fortune is sure to come your way.
ja: そうすれば、良い富と幸運が絶対にやってくるらしいぜ。

key: But that's just a superstition, right?
en: But that's just a superstition, right?
ja: でも、それってただの迷信だよな?

key: I'm sure you just raided Team Meteor's coffers or something instead!
en: I'm sure you just raided Team Meteor's coffers or something instead!
ja: どうせ、チームメテオの金庫でも襲ったんだろうけど!
